findings.observation: All four finite Number( token ) = 0.1 inputs correctly reject loss of decimal value, but runtime scales approximately fourfold when n doubles. The unanchored /0+$/ restarts across a long internal run of zeros before the final 1. This violates the specified linear work bound and occupies the synchronous event loop before rejection.
